There are 60 minutes in an hour.

Regarding the competitor's strategy, Streamline Autos' direct-to-consumer (DTC) model for electric vehicles presents a significant threat to traditional automotive sales structures. By eliminating dealership markups, they can offer more competitive pricing, which may pressure our margins or force us to reconsider our own pricing strategies. Furthermore, their direct engagement allows them to gather first-party data on consumer behavior, enabling more personalized marketing and product development. To mitigate this impact, we should evaluate our own customer touchpoints, consider enhancing our digital sales capabilities, and emphasize the value proposition of our existing dealership network, such as immediate service availability and local trust, which DTC models often lack.
